h1: Custom Direct to Garment T Shirts
metaTitle: Custom Direct to Garment T Shirts | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom direct to garment t shirts for vibrant, full-color designs. Perfect for events or teams. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Direct to garment printing uses specialized inkjet technology to apply detailed, full-color designs directly onto fabric. Unlike screen printing, DTG handles complex gradients and photographic images with ease, making it ideal for small to medium runs of custom t shirts. Choose this method when your artwork demands rich color accuracy and a soft hand feel, without minimum order constraints.
heroAltText: Custom direct to garment t shirts with vibrant full-color design and soft fabric feel
